verdict.rationale: Graphite documents AI reviews that, once enabled, run automatically in the background on every new pull request, and its pricing page lists an "Automations" feature. However, that feature has no documentation in the pack, and Agents are triggered by the user per request rather than running on their own. missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation rules or triggers, scheduled or recurring background agent runs, docs describing the Automations feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
AI reviews powered by Graphite Agent help your team build better software by automatically reviewing pull requests and catching bugs before they ship.
